references.observed: Slender taupe body, pale belly and dark lower-flank stripe, small eyes and five separate gill slits, black dorsal cap with pale margin, swept thick pectorals, small second dorsal and asymmetric caudal lobes.

limitations: Original Carcharhinus melanopterus visual study based on the inspected Klaus Stiefel photograph. Gill slits and closed ventral mouth use shallow authored relief rather than open cavities; fine denticles and teeth are simplified. Swimming is artist-tuned, not measured behavior.
